subject: Acme Supply — invoice intake channel, PO stamping, and template Q&A
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-supply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Supply — invoice intake channel, PO stamping, and template Q&A

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for partnering with us. We’re finalizing the vendor onboarding checklist and want to lock the invoice intake path so AP has a smooth first month. A couple of quick items we need your preference on and one ask about PO stamps: 

1) Preferred invoice submission channel: our standard options are (a) secure vendor portal (recommended) or (b) emailed PDF to ap@acme-supply.com (we’ll whitelist a Redwood address). The portal gives immediate status, automated PO matching, and fewer manual exceptions.

2) PO stamping / PO reference: Redwood requires the PO number on the invoice and ideally a visible "PO stamp" in the header for automated matching. We can accept the PO number in the invoice lines if your system can’t add a stamp — we’ll need a confirmation.

3) Template check: attached is a sample invoice template we use (sample_invoice_template.xlsx). Can you confirm you can export invoices in a format close to that? If not, tell us what fields you can provide.

Attachments: acme_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor onboarding form), sample_invoice_template.xlsx (Excel)

If portal is OK we’ll send an invite; if email is preferred we’ll provide the address and sample subject line to ensure automated ingestion.

Next steps: please reply with preferred channel, whether your invoices can include a visible PO stamp, and any questions about the template.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-supply.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Supply AP <ap@acme-supply.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Supply — invoice intake channel, PO stamping, and template Q&A

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers below: 

1) Channel: We can use your vendor portal but need the invite and an SSO link if possible. If not, email to ap@acme-supply.com is fine as a fallback.

2) PO stamping: Our ERP (Sapphire) does not automatically print a separate "PO stamp" in the invoice header, but it will include the PO number on the invoice lines header and as a reference field. Would that be sufficient for your matcher? If not, we can add a custom header field via a small config change (may take 3–5 business days).

3) Template: We can export to a CSV/Excel that contains the fields in your sample. The only caveat is our bank remittance block is a separate PDF attachment rather than inline. Will that break your ingestion?

If the portal supports sending the remittance PDF as an attachment linked to the invoice record that would work. Otherwise, we can combine into a single PDF on our side.

--
Sarah Li
Vendor Operations Manager
Acme Supply
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Subject: Fwd: Acme Supply — invoice intake channel, PO stamping, and template Q&A

Forwarding Acme's responses — see below. Two quick internal notes / asks: 

- Our matcher team prefers a visible PO field (header or dedicated field) but can map a line-level PO with a higher exception rate. If Acme can enable the header field via config, that will reduce manual review.

- If Acme retains the remittance as a separate PDF, we need the portal to attach it as a child document; otherwise, Marissa can accept a combined PDF for the first 2 months while we finalize portal integration.

Marissa — can you confirm exception tolerance (manual reviews per 100 invoices) if we map PO from line-level only? Also, can Dev spin up a temporary vendor portal invite that supports attachments + SSO?

Karthik
Senior Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Supply — invoice intake channel, PO stamping, and template Q&A

Thanks everyone — final decision and next actions below.

Decision: use vendor portal as primary intake, email to ap@acme-supply.com as fallback for first 30 days. Acme confirmed they can surface the PO number in a header field with a 3–5 business day config change; they will proceed with that change. Until the header is enabled, we will accept the line-level PO mapping with the understanding there will be higher exceptions.

Action items:
- Dev Patel: create a portal invite for Acme with SSO placeholder and attachment capability. (ETA: Mon 1/18)
- Rachel Kim: send onboarding form link (DocuSign) and confirm the remittance handling preference (combined PDF or attached remittance).
- Acme AP / Sarah: implement header PO field (ETA 3–5 business days) and confirm when complete.
- Marissa Cole: monitor first 100 invoices and report exception rate; escalate if >8% mismatch.

Notes: we’ll use the sample_invoice_template.xlsx fields as our canonical mapping. If Acme sends a separate remittance PDF, Dev — please ensure our ingestion pipeline picks up the child PDF and links it to the invoice record.

Attachments: acme_onboarding_form.pdf (DocuSign link sent)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Lead, Redwood Inference
